description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). Z(2 rows, numbers) created first, then A(3 rows, letters); then M(3 rows, numbers) created first, then B(2 rows, letters): creation order and name order disagree, sizes as in cross-sizes. SELECT both columns FROM Z, A; FROM A, Z; FROM M, B; FROM B, M. Asks whether creation order (the catalog's table id) or the name decides when the sizes do not.
